_about: IPRPS Table dice buttons. Copy this file to /etc/iprps-table/presets.json to change it; the Table uses that copy first. kind is one of: check, initiative, trinity, dual, convergence, rps, expr (any dice, with optional band A or B for a single d20). Restart the Table after editing: sudo systemctl restart iprps-table

presets.label: Skill check
presets.help: 1d20 + Skill Shift (Skill ÷ 10) + Attribute Shift (Attribute − 10). Band from the d20.

presets.label: Reaction
presets.help: Placeholder: 1d20 read on the Effectiveness bands. Appearance and Status tiers modify reaction rolls: put your table's reaction rule here.

presets.label: Trinity Hand
presets.help: Mode 2: 1d3 Velocity + 1d20 Impact + 1d12 Guard. More Impact dice = Hydra Hand.

presets.label: Dual-Die attack
presets.help: Mode 4: 1d20 + shifts vs Guard; on a hit, 1d6 Impact severity.

presets.label: Infinite Convergence
presets.help: Mode 5: choose a Blur level. Maximum die results explode.

presets.label: RPS stance
presets.help: Mode 3: Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock.
